The best online co-op games on PS Plus

Your friends don't have to be on the same sofa. These are our ten favourite online co-op games on PS Plus right now, picked for how much fun they are together rather than by score alone. Each one says how many can join, so you can find one that fits your group, whether that's one friend or a full squad. The full list of games with online co-op follows.

What counts as online co-op

Online co-op means playing together over the internet, each on your own console, on the same team. Competitive-only multiplayer isn't counted, and neither are games whose co-op only works on one console.

Each friend needs the game too, either through their own PS Plus Extra or Premium membership or by buying it, and online play needs PS Plus for everyone. We check each game by hand for online co-op and how many players can join.

1

Helldivers 2

Online, up to 4 players · PS5 · Metascore 82 · about 33 h main story

You and up to three friends drop onto alien planets to spread "managed democracy", completing objectives while bugs and robots swarm in from every direction. Friendly fire is always on, which is half the fun, and every mission feeds into a galaxy-wide war that the whole community fights together.

2

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2

Online, up to 3 players · PS5 · Metascore 82 · about 9.6 h main story

A loud, brutal third-person shooter where you and two friends take on endless tides of alien Tyranids as towering Space Marines. The whole campaign can be played in co-op, and the separate Operations missions are built for a full squad.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut

Online, up to 4 players · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 83 · 97% recommend on OpenCritic · about 25 h main story

The main game is a single-player samurai epic, but it also includes Legends, a free co-op mode drawn from Japanese folklore. You pick a class, team up with friends and fight through story missions, survival waves and a full raid.

4

Abiotic Factor

Online, up to 6 players · PS5 · Metascore 88 · about 44 h main story

A survival crafting game set in a secret underground research lab where everything has gone wrong. You and your friends are scientists, not soldiers, so you scavenge, build and science your way past monsters from other dimensions. It's funny, clever and much better with a group.

5

Nioh

Online, 2 players · PS4 · Metascore 88 · about 35 h main story

A tough samurai action game set in a fantasy version of feudal Japan, full of demons and deep, precise combat. Calling in a friend to help with a boss that's been beating you for an hour is one of its great pleasures.

6

Tetris Effect: Connected

Online, up to 3 players · PS4 · Metascore 88 · about 3.3 h main story

Tetris at its most beautiful, with music and visuals that react to every move. The Connected mode lets three players combine their boards to take down a boss together, which is unlike any Tetris you've played.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Warhammer: Vermintide 2

Online, up to 4 players · PS4 · Metascore 82 · about 11 h main story

A first-person action game where four heroes hold the line against hordes of rat-men and Chaos warriors. Its satisfying melee combat and teamwork-heavy missions have kept a loyal crowd playing for years.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Far Cry 5

Online, 2 players · PS4 · Metascore 81 · about 18 h main story

A cult has taken over a corner of rural Montana, and you're there to take it back. The whole open-world campaign can be played with a friend, which turns its explosive, unpredictable fights into a great night of shared chaos.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Tom Clancy's The Division 2

Online, up to 4 players · PS4 · Metascore 82 · about 26 h main story

A cover-based shooter with loot, set in a Washington, D.C. falling apart after a pandemic. Taking back the city block by block with a full squad is where it shines, and there's a huge amount to do.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Dying Light 2 Stay Human

Online, up to 4 players · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 76 · about 24 h main story

Run, climb and leap across the rooftops of a zombie-infested city, and stay off the streets after dark. The parkour feels great on its own and even better racing friends across the skyline.

Questions

Do I need PS Plus to play co-op online?

Yes, for most games. Online play on PS4 and PS5 needs a PS Plus subscription at any tier, though free-to-play games are the exception.

Does my friend need their own copy?

Yes, each player needs the game, from their own PS Plus Extra subscription or a purchase. On PS5, Share Play lets a friend join your game remotely without owning it, as long as you both have PS Plus.

Which co-op games let me play with friends on Xbox or PC?

Helldivers 2 supports crossplay, and so do several others. Our crossplay list has them all.

What's the best online co-op game for two players?

Far Cry 5 lets two of you play the whole campaign together, and Nioh is great for tackling tough bosses as a pair.

What's the best online co-op game for a group of four?

Helldivers 2, Ghost of Tsushima's Legends mode, Vermintide 2, The Division 2 and Dying Light 2 all take four players. Abiotic Factor takes up to six.

Can we play on the same sofa instead?

Most of these are online only. Our couch co-op list has the best games to play together on one console.
